cases.case: bundle contract status maps to the shared contract refusal
cases.error: Function orders bundle must be a self-contained ESM module exporting handle.

hint.remedy: Rebuild the Server Artifact so each bundle exports handle and has no module imports.

cases.error: The function component requires ABI konae-functions-wasm/1.

hint.remedy: Install a preparer and runner that support konae-functions-wasm/1.

cases.error: The function component SHA-256 does not match its manifest.

hint.remedy: Check the preparer output and its manifest, then prepare the function again.

cases.error: The function component has an import outside the allowed host interface.

hint.remedy: Install a preparer that emits only the host imports in the runner WIT.

cases.error: The function component must export the required runner interface with matching types.

hint.remedy: Install a preparer that emits the runner exports in the runner WIT.

cases.error: The function component is not valid WebAssembly.

hint.remedy: Check the preparer and component packaging, then prepare the function again.

cases.error: A function uses an API that StarlingMonkey does not support.

hint.remedy: Remove the unsupported API from the function bundle.

cases.error: A function must finish its top-level initialization before it can run.

hint.remedy: Make top-level initialization finish before the function handles requests.

cases.error: A function cannot start timers or fetch during top-level initialization.

hint.remedy: Move timers and fetch calls out of top-level initialization.

cases.error: A function failed during top-level initialization.

hint.remedy: Fix the function's top-level initialization error.

cases.error: Function component preparation exceeded its build limits.

hint.remedy: Reduce work and memory use during function initialization.
